scope: project-only; no global memory or policy change
problem: The exported project excludes private .processing-data, but the builder previously required its xiongnu-raw.glb to reconstruct the collection.
rootCause: The builder coupled a durable collection input to a transient generation cache even though the same verified raw bytes already existed in the collection snapshot.
minimalFix: Read and hash-check the runtime raw first; only ENOENT permits reading the durable collector raw snapshot. Read the buffer before updating that same snapshot directory.

validation.offlineReconstruction: An isolated project with no .processing-data rebuilt from its own collection snapshot; all eight GLB hashes and book.json matched.

constraints: No real runtime file was renamed, removed or changed.
No paid generation or credential access was performed.
A retained raw snapshot is required when the runtime cache is absent; incorrect raw SHA or byte count remains an error.
rollbackCondition: Revert the fallback only if valid existing runtime inputs stop rebuilding; retain the offline regression test and choose another durable raw-input path.
